turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I get an hour for lunch at work and there's a tiny gym in the basement.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice perk. You could do a fast twenty minute circuit there, or just take a brisk walk outside and get some daylight. What do you need more at midday?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on a minute, I want to ask Chloe something first. Don't jump in until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So if I get this job, would you actually be okay moving up north?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Honestly? I've been thinking about it all week.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I'd miss my sister. But my work is remote anyway, so it's not like I'd lose anything there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could come back every month or so.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Every month is a lot of driving. Let's see if you even get an offer before we start packing boxes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fair. You're right, one step at a time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, that took a while. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. The lunch hour question. Circuit or walk?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A walk. I stare at screens all day.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good choice. Even thirty minutes outside will lift your energy for the afternoon.
